{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of the channel column
channel_counts = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the customer_segment column
segment_counts = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the converted column
converted_counts = sales_df['converted'].value_counts()

# Check the data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
age_sentinel = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]

# Print the results
print("Missing values:")
print(missing_values)
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(channel_counts)
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(segment_counts)
print("\nConverted distribution:")
print(converted_counts)
print("\nData types:")
print(dtypes)
print("\nRows with sentinel value (-1) in customer_age:")
print(age_sentinel.head())"}
